2.1.1.title: Clean Package Migration, Live TV Rewind, English CC & Safe Search
2.1.1.releaseNotes:
• Clean Package Migration: Migrated package identifier to com.tvdinner, removing all legacy developer tags
• Live TV Rewind: Use remote Left button to step back up to 2 minutes in live stream buffer
• Return to Live: Use remote Right button to advance toward live feed (right button becomes no-op once at live)
• English Closed Captions: Automatic prioritization of English subtitle/CC tracks whenever captions are enabled
• Adult Search Isolation: Adult items are strictly excluded from search results unless an adult category tab is selected

2.1.0.title: Reliable OTA Installer, High-Contrast Search Focus & Remote Enhancements
2.1.0.releaseNotes:
• OTA Update Reliability: Instant package installer launch with cached APK persistence (no re-download required) and unknown app permission handling
• Distinct Version Details: Accurate, version-specific release notes for each release in update dialogs
• High-Contrast Search Focus: Search bars across Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts glow bright cyan/blue when focused
• Music Fast Skipping: Ultra-responsive YouTube track transitions using loadVideoById with zero playback dropouts
• Podcasts Remote Navigation: Press D-Pad UP during podcast playback to immediately jump to the previous episode

2.0.9.title: VOD Watchlist, Live TV Quality Badges & Marquee Title Scrolling
2.0.9.releaseNotes:
• VOD Watchlist: Click and hold (remote D-Pad center or touch hold) on any movie or TV series card to save to Watchlist
• ⭐ Watchlist Category: Added at the top of Movies and Series categories with gold indicator badges on saved titles
• Live TV Quality Badges: Replaced bulky logo boxes with sleek quality badge pills (4K, FHD, HD, UHD, SD)
• Marquee Title Scrolling: Automatic horizontal marquee scrolling for long titles on focused cards and preview panel

2.0.8.title: Cross-Category Remote Focus & Closed Caption Remote Toggle
2.0.8.releaseNotes:
• Live TV Navigation: Seamlessly return to channels from preview panel even when browsing a foreign category
• Closed Captions: Press Remote D-Pad Down during VOD movie/series playback to toggle Closed Captions (Subtitles) ON/OFF
• On-Screen CC HUD: Visual toast pill overlay displaying current subtitle status

2.0.7.title: Portal Settings, Failover URL & Live TV Stream Reconnect
2.0.7.releaseNotes:
• Settings: Added Primary & Backup Portal URL configuration fields
• Failover URL: Built-in backup portal recovery (http://vpn.uhd4.top:80) for streaming drop recovery
• Stream Reconnect: Added socket eviction & Reconnect Streams button to instantly refresh connections without restarting app
